findings.description: SYS-SUP-033 relies on SYS-SUP-051 to select the reported state, but CON-SUP-125 does not establish which state applies during fault handling, for a start-up fault, or after a code 8 report. OP-SYS-015 records these unresolved cases.
findings.requested_change: Obtain the state-selection decision and apply it to SYS-SUP-051 so the expected status response is determined for those histories.

findings.description: CON-SUP-107 and CON-SUP-124 specify the CRC polynomial but not the initial value, input and output reflection, final XOR, or stored-reference byte order. The expected comparison result for a given image and reference is not unique.
findings.requested_change: Obtain the missing CRC parameters and reference byte order and specify them for the start-up code comparison.

findings.description: The run-time CRC comparison lacks the initial value, input and output reflection, final XOR, and reference byte order. CON-SUP-124 identifies the polynomial and reference location but does not determine a unique comparison result.
findings.requested_change: Obtain the missing CRC parameters and reference byte order and specify them for the run-time code comparison.

findings.description: CON-SUP-125 lists state labels without transition rules. SYS-SUP-051 selects STARTUP or OPERATIONAL between fault detection and safe-state entry, including during a start-up fault and after a code 8 report, although OP-SYS-015 identifies these cases as undecided.
findings.requested_change: Obtain the state-selection decision for the cases in OP-SYS-015 and align SYS-SUP-051 with it.

findings.description: The configuration integrity comparison specifies only the CRC polynomial. OP-SYS-014 records missing CRC parameters and stored CRC byte order, so the expected result for a given configuration block and reference cannot yet be determined.
findings.requested_change: Obtain the missing CRC parameters and stored CRC byte order and specify them for the configuration comparison.
